title: spawn_tree_schema.json
description: Spawn tree stub (F5, A6): a placeholder entity so autonomous spawn trees are not forced into agent rows or crew bindings. v1 carries only an id, a root and a placeholder for aggregates. aggregates_state is always 'not_computed' in v1; no counters exist yet and none may be invented. No lineage edges, birth records or terminal records are defined here (F2: no producer yet). root_cluster_ref points at an identity cluster, not a crew; crews are owned by the crews design.

aggregates_state.description: Placeholder. A later contract may add computed states and counters additively.
